source_claim: Three distinct official routes were checked for the residual exact members oomiya_aine and tojo_seira. They did not establish a safe direct HOME relation to Idol Wars for those two members.

checked_routes.result: DMM GAMES confirms the exact Idol Wars title and that service ended on 2026-02-24; the current official listing has no character roster and does not identify Omiya Aine or Tojo Seira.

Edia identifies itself as the game operator and its official fifth-anniversary release explicitly covers seven packet characters in the companion AUTHORITY_BATCH. It does not name Omiya Aine or Tojo Seira.

Sushi soft explicitly identifies Omiya Aine as an ODA idol candidate alongside Reika Aiba in its Reika title. This establishes Aine in that developer-published title, but the page does not identify her as an Idol Wars character or provide a safe canonical mapping to the Idol Wars Copyright; it does not name Tojo Seira.

notes: Partial campaign progress only. Preserve the seven positive relations in the companion AUTHORITY_BATCH. The official developer route surfaced a separate linked title for Omiya Aine but did not establish her canonical Idol Wars HOME; do not treat this outcome as negative evidence or as a terminal decision. Tojo Seira remains unresolved.
